description: This file implements the xxHash 64-bit hash function in Go, including the Digest type, hash computation methods, and binary serialization.

classes.name: Digest
classes.description: A struct implementing the xxHash 64-bit hash algorithm with internal state and methods for hashing data.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the Digest to its initial state with seed zero.

methods.name: ResetWithSeed
methods.description: Resets the Digest with a specified seed value.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the hash output in bytes (8).

methods.name: BlockSize
methods.description: Returns the block size used in hashing (32 bytes).

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Adds data to the hash computation.

methods.name: Sum
methods.description: Returns the current hash appended to the provided byte slice.

methods.name: Sum64
methods.description: Computes and returns the current hash value as uint64.

methods.name: MarshalBinary
methods.description: Serializes the Digest state into a byte slice.

methods.name: UnmarshalBinary
methods.description: Deserializes the Digest state from a byte slice.
